university.name: University of Aberdeen
university.summary: The University of Aberdeen teaches full-time on-campus degrees at its Aberdeen campus. Its Finance degree page reports a community of over 130 nationalities, and its funding pages list the Aberdeen Global Scholarship, an automatic tuition waiver for eligible self-funded international students.

courses.title: Finance
courses.overview: A four-year undergraduate finance degree covering finance, risk, investment, financial markets, corporate finance and a final-year dissertation. The page states ICAS accreditation. Year 1 includes optional course choices alongside compulsory courses.
highlights: Finance 1: Finance, Risk and Investment (Year 1, compulsory)
courses.academic_requirements: The course page gives only a short summary and refers to a separate entry requirements section; no Highers, A-levels or IB points were read. Pakistan page: HSSC average of 75% or better, and 75% in Mathematics for Accountancy, Economics or Finance degrees.
courses.english_requirements: General undergraduate (IELTS Academic or UKVI Academic only): overall 6.0, Listening 5.5, Reading 5.5, Speaking 5.5, Writing 6.0. PTE Academic overall 59 with 59 in each component. Duolingo (tests from 1 July 2024) overall 105, Listening 95, Reading 95, Speaking 95, Writing 105. TOEFL iBT for tests from 21 January 2026: overall 4 to 4.5, Listening 4, Reading 4, Speaking 4, Writing 4.5; before that date overall 78. The page does not map programmes to tiers.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: Higher Secondary School Certificate (science or arts) average of 75% or better; Accountancy, Economics or Finance degrees also need 75% in Mathematics. Applicants not eligible for direct Year 1 entry may apply for a Foundation Year.
courses.career_notes: The page lists roles such as financial analyst, portfolio manager and risk management consultant, and states accreditation by ICAS.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published; GBP 20,800 is the 2026/27 EU/International fee shown on the course page and the 2026/27 fees document. The fees document says fees are subject to annual review and modular courses should budget for a 3% to 9% increase per annum. The page also shows a self-funded price of GBP 14,800 that includes the GBP 6,000 Aberdeen Global Scholarship. September intake year not stated. TOEFL iBT scale changed on 21 January 2026, so min_toefl is left null. Highlights are modules the page lists for the year shown.

courses.title: Data Science
courses.duration_text: 12 months (September start) or 16 months (January start), full-time on campus
courses.overview: A taught master's on campus in Aberdeen covering programming in Python and R, statistics, machine learning, data visualisation and image analysis, ending in a 60 credit data science project. All listed courses are compulsory.
courses.academic_requirements: A 2:2 (lower second class) Honours degree or equivalent in any subject will be considered. Documents: CV, degree certificate, full transcript and personal statement.
courses.english_requirements: Postgraduate tiers (IELTS Academic or UKVI Academic only): overall 6.5 in both tiers; Standard tier Listening 5.5, Reading 5.5, Speaking 5.5, Writing 6.0; Higher tier Reading 6.0 with the others the same. PTE Academic overall 62 with 59 in each component. Duolingo overall 120 (Listening 95, Speaking 95, Writing 105; Reading 95 Standard or 105 Higher). TOEFL iBT for tests from 21 January 2026: overall 4.5 with 4 in each component. The course page does not say which tier applies.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: applicants typically need a 4 year Bachelors Degree. A GPA of 2.6 is described as comparable to a UK 2.2, which the page puts at around 65% depending on the institution's grading scale. The page gives the figure as GPA, not CGPA, and gives no scale.
courses.career_notes: The page lists roles such as data scientist, business intelligence analyst, data architect and data mining engineer.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published; GBP 26,250 is the 2026/27 EU/International fee on the course page and the 2026/27 postgraduate taught fees document, which advises budgeting for an increase of 5% to 9% per annum. The page also shows a self-funded price of GBP 18,250 that includes the GBP 8,000 Aberdeen Global Scholarship. Intake years not stated on the page. The 12 month fee covers the whole course. Highlights are the compulsory September start courses.

courses.title: Petroleum Engineering
courses.overview: A twelve-month taught master's on campus in Aberdeen covering reservoir engineering, well testing, petrophysics, enhanced oil recovery and field development, with a 60 credit individual project. The page states accreditation by the Energy Institute and the Institution of Mechanical Engineers.
highlights: Field Development, Petroleum Economics and Simulation
courses.academic_requirements: A 2:2 UK Honours degree, or equivalent non-UK Honours degree, in Engineering or Applied Mathematics. Geology, Physics or Chemistry degrees may be considered with a 2:2 and 2 or more years of relevant work experience. Key subjects: Mathematics and Physics.
courses.english_requirements: Postgraduate tiers (IELTS Academic or UKVI Academic only): overall 6.5 in both tiers; Standard tier Listening 5.5, Reading 5.5, Speaking 5.5, Writing 6.0; Higher tier Reading 6.0 with the others the same. PTE Academic overall 62 with 59 in each component. Duolingo overall 120 (Listening 95, Speaking 95, Writing 105; Reading 95 Standard or 105 Higher). TOEFL iBT for tests from 21 January 2026: overall 4.5 with 4 in each component. The course page does not say which tier applies.
courses.experience_requirements: Geology, Physics or Chemistry graduates need 2 or more years of relevant work experience.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: applicants typically need a 4 year Bachelors Degree. A GPA of 2.6 is described as comparable to a UK 2.2, which the page puts at around 65% depending on the institution's grading scale. The page gives the figure as GPA, not CGPA, and gives no scale.
courses.career_notes: The page lists drilling, production, reservoir, subsurface and operations engineering roles.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published; GBP 26,250 is the 2026/27 EU/International fee for Petroleum Engineering (On Campus Delivery) in the 2026/27 postgraduate taught fees document. The page also shows a self-funded price of GBP 18,250 that includes the GBP 8,000 Aberdeen Global Scholarship. September intake year not stated. Students needing a UK visa must obtain ATAS clearance (page states CAH code CAH10-01-09). Highlights are compulsory September start courses; the page lists no optional courses.

scholarships.name: Aberdeen Global Scholarship (Postgraduate)
scholarships.summary: An automatic tuition fee waiver for self-funded, full-time, on-campus Masters students with international fee status, taught or research, starting in 2026/27 or 2027/28 at the Aberdeen campus.
scholarships.criteria_text: Self-funded, full-time, on-campus Masters students with international fee status starting 2026/27 or 2027/28. Aberdeen campus only; not for DPLP, PGDE or Dentistry. Not for students fully sponsored or holding other fully funded or University of Aberdeen scholarships, except Development Trust awards.
scholarships.deadline_note: Available until further notice. Applied automatically and shown on the CAS.
scholarships.notes: Pakistan appears in the page's countries list; eligibility is based on fee status, not nationality.

scholarships.name: Aberdeen Global Scholarship (Undergraduate)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 6,000 for every year of the programme, as a partial tuition waiver
scholarships.summary: An automatic partial tuition waiver for new self-funded, full-time, on-campus undergraduate students with international fee status starting in 2026/27 or 2027/28 at the Aberdeen campus.
scholarships.criteria_text: Self-funded, full-time, on-campus students with international fee status. Aberdeen campus only; not for DPLP, Dentistry or Medicine. Not for students fully sponsored or holding other fully funded or University of Aberdeen scholarships, except Development Trust awards.
scholarships.deadline_note: Available until further notice. Applied automatically and shown on the CAS.
scholarships.notes: Pakistan appears in the page's countries list; eligibility is based on fee status, not nationality. Continuing students keep the award they received when they started.

scholarships.name: Aberdeen Alumni Discount
scholarships.value_text: 20% off the full cost of eligible self-funded study
scholarships.summary: A 20% discount for University of Aberdeen graduates, open to Home, RUK and international fee payers, on listed programmes such as the MBA, online taught postgraduate programmes and the first year of full-time research degrees.
scholarships.criteria_text: Hold an Aberdeen undergraduate or postgraduate degree (certificates and diplomas do not qualify) or have studied at Aberdeen as an exchange, study abroad or Erasmus student. Self-funded, new student, applying for an eligible programme.
scholarships.deadline_note: Available until further notice. Cannot be applied for after starting.
scholarships.notes: Eligible programmes are a listed set and do not include the on-campus MSc courses recorded in this file. Intake year not stated on the page.
